info.name: OpenText™ Core Application Security Web API Explorer ApiKeyManagement MobileScans API

params.name: releaseId
params.description: The release id

info.name: Starts a mobile scan for the given release

params.name: releaseId
params.description: The release id

params.name: startDate
params.description: The start date for the scan in MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm format

params.name: assessmentTypeId
params.description:
The assessment type id for the scan

Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/assessment-types

params.name: frameworkType
params.description: The framework type id. Only iOS and Android are supported at this time

params.name: timeZone
params.description:
The time zone

Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=TimeZones

params.name: fragNo
params.description: -1 indicates the fragment of bytes has been sent. The value starts with 0 and increments by 1 for each fragment of bytes sent

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the bytes sent. 0 indicates the first bytes

params.name: entitlementId
params.description: The entitlement id to consume

params.name: entitlementFrequencyType
params.description: The entitlement frequency type

params.name: fileName
params.description: The uploaded file name with extension

params.name: isRemediationScan
params.description: Indicates if the scan is a remediation scan. Value defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: isBundledAssessment
params.description: Indicates if the assessment is a bundled assessment. If not supplied legacy behavior will apply. Value defaults to null if not specified.

params.name: parentAssessmentTypeId
params.description: The parent assessment type id for the bundled assessment. If not supplied legacy behavior will apply

params.name: scanMethodType
params.description: The method of starting a scan

params.name: scanTool
params.description: The tool used for scanning

params.name: scanToolVersion
params.description: The version for the scan tool used for scanning

info.name: Saves the contents to import scan file

params.name: releaseId
params.description: Release Id of the scan to import

params.name: fragNo
params.description: -1 indicates the fragment of bytes has been sent. The value starts with 0 and increments by 1 for each fragment of bytes sent

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the bytes sent. 0 indicates the first bytes

params.name: fileLength
params.description: The number of bytes of the file being imported

params.name: importScanSessionId
params.description: The unique importScanSessionId to use for the session provided by GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/import-scan-session-id
